Blurbs.Reason Code: What is an undelivered package?
Blurbs.Blurb Text Edited:
Hi [NAME],

Thank you for contacting Amazon Flex.

Undelivered packages are packages that you tried to deliver, but were unable to. Examples of why you may not have been able to deliver a package could include:

- A package required a customer signature, but they weren't home.

- There wasn't a safe place to leave the package.

- You were not able to find the address.

Here are some suggestions to return undelivered packages:

- After completing your route, the Amazon Flex app will notify you of packages to return. Choose Return to station now or Return by 10 a.m. tomorrow.

- If you choose Return to station now, you'll be routed back to the original Pickup Location. When you arrive back at the original Pickup Location, follow the instructions in the Amazon Flex app to scan the undelivered packages.

- If you're having difficulties locating the designated return area. Ask for a station associate in Amazon Fresh locations. In Store locations, you can get help by contacting Support in the app by selecting: ? > Driver Support.

- Once you have scanned the relevant packages. Be sure to "Swipe to Finish" to complete the package return process.

- If you choose Return by 10 a.m. tomorrow, a reminder task will be created within your itinerary in the app. The next day, open the app and select Return to Station in the itinerary's task. Follow the instructions in the app to scan the packages with your phone before placing them in the returns area.

- Once you arrive at the station, follow the instructions in the Amazon Flex app to scan the undelivered packages. If you have difficulties, contact Support in the app by selecting: ? > Driver Support.

- If something unexpected happened that prevents you from returning packages on time, please contact Support in the Amazon Flex app.

For faster access to Support, try live chat by signing in to the Amazon Flex app and going to the main menu > Help > Contact us.

Thank you for delivering with Amazon Flex.

The Amazon Flex Team.

Undelivered packages are packages that you tried to deliver, but were unable to. Examples of why you may not have been able to deliver a package could include:

- After completing your route, the Amazon Flex app will notify you of packages to return. Choose Return to station now or Return by 10 a.m. tomorrow.

- Once you have scanned the relevant packages. Be sure to "Swipe to Finish" to complete the package return process.

- If you choose Return by 10 a.m. tomorrow, a reminder task will be created within your itinerary in the app. The next day, open the app and select Return to Station in the itinerary's task. Follow the instructions in the app to scan the packages with your phone before placing them in the returns area.

- Once you arrive at the station, follow the instructions in the Amazon Flex app to scan the undelivered packages. If you have difficulties, contact Support in the app by selecting: ? > Driver Support.
